title: Trustworthy AI: Safety, Bias, and Privacy – A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model reliance on weakly predictive, causally unrelated features (e.g., background colors, eyeglasses) by measuring Worst-Group Accuracy on shifted test environments where the learned spurious correlations no longer hold.

Measuring the worst-group test accuracy of female samples with eyeglasses in a gender classification task, demonstrating how deep neural networks disproportionately rely on heuristics when eyeglasses are highly correlated with male samples in the training data.
